facts.value: The public constructor it_80294DC0 selects resting state 0 only after successful creation; the distinct Logic31_Spawned callback selects falling state 1. Resting entry clears velocity. Pickup selects state 2 and hides model subtree 3; dropping selects state 1 with literal mask 6 and reveals that subtree; EnteredAir selects state 4. State 3 has callbacks but no direct selector in this unit. Every table entry has animation ID -1, so common state changes remove JObj animation and null the script pointer before installing callbacks, rather than reloading animation/script data. State-0 collision can enter 1 on support loss, state-1 collision can restore 0 after qualifying landing checks, and state-4 collision selects 1 without floor support or conditionally restores 0 under its supported-contact guard. Constant-false local callbacks do not exclude lifetime handling in shared item code.
